params.topic: English Premier League historical football data gaps for an auditable Qimen replay and odds-interval study
questions: For Premier League seasons 2018/19, 2021/22, 2024/25 and 2025/26, identify public, verifiable row-level sources that can fill only the currently missing fields in a local fixture inventory: Bet365 1X2 opening/closing, Pinnacle 1X2 opening/closing, William Hill 1X2 opening/closing, and Bet365 over/under opening when present. Keep bookmakers and opening/closing semantics separate; do not substitute API-Football for bookmaker odds.

Prioritize exact matching by season, kickoff date, home team, away team, and a stable source URL. Return source URL, field semantics, timestamp semantics, coverage counts, unmatched counts, duplicate/conflict counts, and concrete rows only when independently verifiable.

For 2018/19 Cardiff and Huddersfield, identify authoritative sources for Premier League competition-entry season, club identity/registration lineage, and home venue/venue coordinates if available. Do not use club founding year as competition-entry year, and do not infer Qimen palaces, F/I/G tokens, or match predictions.

For every unavailable, ambiguous, or source-exhausted field report unavailable or blocked with the reason. Never infer opening from closing, never infer William Hill/Pinnacle/Bet365 from another bookmaker, and never use match outcome or odds to reconstruct Qimen chart tokens. State whether any result is sufficient for a strict crosswalk into a local case_id and complete pre-match qimen_output.json.
